releases.name: Dark Dice Dungeon
releases.summary: If you are keen on classic sudocu, chess, chequers or mahjong, this game will definitely appeal to you. Designed hundreds years ago this excellent logic game was inaccessible for a long time. Due to simple and user-friendly interface you will find the game easy and ABSORBING. The goal is simple - fill the magic square to get rows, columns and main diagonals having sums equal to 65. Do it by moving purple numbers from the right field to open spots on the left field while grey numbers remain static. The game trains your logic. Sudocu 65 is a real time killer for those who like to tease their brains. DIFFERENT LEVELS OF DIFFICULTY Choose the right difficulty level, improve your results and publish them in the "Game Center"HINTS If you can't find a right solution for a long time, you can always use a hint. It will guide your mind in a right direction.

They have those attributes that inspire the kids as they wanna look like them or wanna fly and fight in angry mood as they do. Kids need to show their skills, as they need to win the race of time matching up the cards. They have to run faster than the timer and finish the matching before time to move to the next level that is more challenging and fun.Leave the guns of the crime and stop racing with the thunder moto cars. It’s time to race with time in memory match. Let’s match the super heroes that look similar. Only a frontlinesuper hero can match the hiddenheroes to secure the place. Flip the cards and see which super hero is hidden behind. Match them all to gain time management skills.***FEATURES***? Amazing and Challenging Game play.? Three Difficulty levels to challenge your time management skills.? 5 addictive game stages.? Tic-Toc timer to test the speed at which your kids are playing.? Best flipping animations.? Scores at the end telling you how fast did you complete the level.? The faster you complete the rack the more scores you earn.? Animated Splash Screen.? Colorful HD images.? Tic-toc timer sound.So don’t wait longer when it’s about getting time management and good memory skills for your preschool kids. Let them be with the super heroes and become one of them. All the BMX loving boys and girls out of the bubble soap would love to be that little agent that can match the heroes like never before. Track the super heroes all the way through card matching to acquire time management and good memory.

releases.name: Knightime
releases.summary: Super fun and easy board game for up to 6 players (pirates) of all ages!The Pirate Treasure Hunt is a classic board game of chance and betting where the goal is to loot an island and fill up your pirate ship with treasure!- Roll the dice and try to get as much loot and treasure of the island as possible!- Steal from or attack other players to get the advantage!- 6 colorful characters to choose from, each with unique voice and personality!- 3 islands to visit, with different amounts of treasure!- Made for iPad! 2-6 players on the same screen! (but works on iphone as well)- Perfect replacement for a classic board game! Realistic dice rolling!- Great as a party game!This is version 1.0. The next version which will also feature:- More music tracks during gameplay!- Additional languages! (swedish, french, spanish, german)- Options for setting up a custom game!

releases.name: The Anomalarian
releases.summary: The house is lying to you. Notice what changed, decide if it's safe, and live with being wrong. A first-person psychological horror game where every room hides an anomaly, your sanity is the only health bar you have, and the things in the dark are watching to see if you'll believe your own eyes.

releases.summary: A tiny idle RPG that lives on your desktop. Park it on your taskbar or anywhere on screen, and four heroes march through 7 acts while you work, study or play. releases.name: Micro Factory
releases.summary: Design your factory, connect machines with conveyor belts, and optimize production. Complete 48 levels across Classic mode and the Industrial Campaign, tackle daily challenges, and unlock 32 collectible cards and 24 in-game achievements. Every connection counts!

releases.name: Imperfect Balance Collection
releases.summary: The three Polarites: the seal, bear and penguin have joined forces. In their end of the season quest for food they encounter some "out of place" obstacles from a place far far away in the video game hall of fame. Join them as they slide across broken ice planks where they must leap up and under the suddenly teleported classic puzzle video game blocks.This game has a purchasable "Kids Mode", which gives your characters unlimited health and uninterrupted gameplay for as long as you choose! Music and sounds provided in part by freesfx.co.ukThanks guys!

releases.name: Kenomas
releases.summary: *** Do you have an eye for details? ***--- A new picture quiz game! ---In Zoom Quiz you will see an object really close up. Your task is to find out exactly what object you are facing with as few “zooms” as possible! Zoom Quiz is the next big challenge for all picture quiz fans out there! FREEZoom Quiz is completely free to try! Just tap the download button and start playing!SIMPLE AND STYLISHPlaying is super simple! Have a look at the photo then spell your answer by clicking on the letters you want to use.GET HINTSGetting a little blurry-eyed? Don’t give up! You have several hint tools at your disposal. Is the picture too close? Zoom out and see if you can solve it now. You can also remove and reveal letters, and you can even use the key icon to skip a tricky question!When you complete enough levels you’re awarded free hints, which you can use later on. You can also purchase hints in the game.HUNDREDS OF QUESTIONSZoom Quiz contains hundreds of different picture challenges! How many can you solve?Can your mind and eyes work together to take on the Zoom Quiz challenge? Tap the download button and find out NOW!

releases.name: Conquisterra Roguelie
releases.summary: A 2D roguelike about escaping a dungeon nightmare, and choosing between a comforting lie or a painful truth.

releases.name: Two Minds One Car
releases.summary: Experience a unique cooperative driving adventure where teamwork is key: one player controls the steering wheel, while the other manages the gas and brake. Success depends on perfect coordination and precise timing.
